scientific_integrity: Direct count and analytic ratio proof supplied. Finite checks are neither exhaustive over unbounded sizes nor an independent certification. The stationary product weight, general local limit theorem, and macroscopic wealth limits are credited to prior literature.
scientific_limitations: Piecewise constant transfer probabilities, symmetric connected graph, positive asymptotic wealth and credit ratios, a_N=o(N), and q_N>=1 only. Three bias regimes cover specified limits, not oscillatory biases or unrestricted a_N. Existing local limit methods can partly imply the balanced endpoint; independent originality review is not performed.
title: Microscopic credit-slack crossover in a stationary debt-capped exchange model
